tool_args.rationale: Five observations at a single horizon and fixed x_now/mem_conv leave genuine mechanistic ambiguity despite the pilot signatures. The target horizon is long relative to the stated tau scale, so a slow-horizon probe is not motivated; an open-branch probe directly tests whether the unobserved branch changes the response.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a fitted stationary model from the five rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observations do not identify the response to the missing/open branch; candidate mechanisms can fit these few samples yet diverge on that branch.
A targeted branch-discriminating observation is more economical than a broad trajectory batch.
It is irrelevant to the identified ambiguity and explicitly should not be purchased.
